title: monticalia peruviana
intro: Monticalia peruviana, commonly known as Peruvian mint, is a plant species in the daisy family. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from digestive issues and alleviating symptoms of stress and anxiety. The health benefits of Monticalia peruviana include its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties, which help in soothing digestive discomfort and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as reducing inflammation and modulating the nervous system.
